The structure of Dy6Cr2Mo2 (reduced formula Dy3CrMo) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 10 atoms in the unit cell distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. CrystalNN geometry-only analysis shows all three elements in tetrahedral environments with four geometric neighbors each: Cr and Mo are surrounded by four Dy neighbors, while Dy has two Cr and two Mo neighbors, with neighbor distances of 2.6899 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component containing all 10 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-sharing between Dy tetrahedra and both Cr and Mo tetrahedra, while Cr and Mo tetrahedra share edges.
